character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Full-body elder male Shaman with an open rounded silhouette, slim slightly stooped frame, gentle visible face, short gray beard and kind turquoise eyes. Layered moss-green woven cloth (#526b45) dominates his tunic, shoulder drape and knee-length side panels; a narrow light-flax underlayer keeps the face and hands readable. Muted turquoise (#3f8f83) marks two simple woven bands and one attached leaf-shaped clasp. Warm wood brown (#76543a) is confined to a few small fasteners, not a full robe. He stands openly with empty hands and soft dark sandals. No beige-dominant outfit, wooden helmet, bark armor, staff, feather crown or floating leaves.
